name: Cover
summary: A bridal hair and makeup artist's home page as a bridal magazine cover: one finished bride full-bleed, the artist's name across the top in a Didone masthead (above her head, or behind it when her photo has room), and cover lines that are the real answers: the next open Saturday or her own date (Open., On hold., Taken.), trial and wedding day for the service she picks, and what time we start for her ceremony and her party; "On the cover" names the look. Then This season, four brides in a plain row with their looks named in italic; the packages as a ruled list with the prices set large; everyone in the chair, priced, the cover's start time moving with it. Warm white page, ink, one fern accent from a garden; the photographs carry the colour in one fresh, warm grade. Libre Bodoni for the masthead, cover lines and figures; Faustina for every sentence. For bridal hair and makeup artists.
